title: Raster River Map: Upstream Area
description: Native-grid raster of Mekong upstream contributing area at river-map cells.
purpose: Show how contributing area varies across the regional river map.
method: Convert m² to km²; mask invalid/non-positive values; YlGnBu palette with full-map logarithmic normalization by default.
data_source: Git-tracked CaMa-Flood Mekong 15-minute map; no simulation output required.
data_preparation: Inputs are already tracked; run visualization/river_map/f01-raster_river_map.sh after standard Python setup.

title: Raster River Map: Basin
description: Original positive integer basin ID raster, without renumbering or replacing IDs with display indices.
purpose: Inspect the original basin ID field and distinguish categorical basin identity from precomputed display colors.
method: One discrete bin per original integer ID; repeat tab20 colors; display-only pseudo-log categorical legend expands IDs 1-20 and compresses higher-ID intervals with representative labels; map normalization unchanged; mask missing/non-positive cells. IDs are categorical, not continuous physical quantities.
data_source: Git-tracked CaMa-Flood Mekong 15-minute map; no simulation output required.
required_data: map/mekong_15min/netcdf/basin.nc (basin, lon, lat; unitless positive integer IDs); map/mekong_15min/params.txt.
data_preparation: Tracked NetCDF input is ready. Basin preparation: map/tools/script_region/s01-regional_map.sh invokes region_set_map.F90; map/tools/script_bin2nc/s02-convert_netcdf.sh prepares individual NetCDF files. Run visualization/river_map/f01-raster_river_map.sh.

title: Raster River Map: Basin Color
description: Precomputed categorical display colors assigned to river basins on the Mekong map.
purpose: Show precomputed basin display indices as a soft background suitable for future overlays while retaining region boundaries.
method: Display bsncol directly with discrete bins for indices 1-10; mix tab10 RGB with 60% opaque white for distinguishable pastel backgrounds; no physical scale or logarithmic normalization.
data_source: Git-tracked CaMa-Flood Mekong 15-minute map; no simulation output required.
data_preparation: Tracked input is ready. map/tools/code/region_set_map.F90, invoked by map/tools/script_region/s01-regional_map.sh, derives display colors using basin information and neighboring-color checks. Run visualization/river_map/f01-raster_river_map.sh.

title: Raster River Map: Subbasin Color
description: Prepared pastel subcol display colors over bsncol network coverage with gray unassigned cells and black edges at adjacent bsncol class changes.
purpose: Show prepared subbasin color classes within the mapped network context; bsncol/subcol colors are categorical display indices, not unique identifiers or physical quantities.
method: Read one little-endian int32 NX*NY subcol record in Fortran order (x varies fastest); draw positive indices 1–10 with tab10 mixed with 60% white; gray valid-bsncol cells with zero/missing subcol; white where bsncol is missing. Draw black shared cell edges where adjacent valid bsncol indices differ. bsncol is a categorical display index, not a basin ID, so repeated classes can hide boundaries between distinct basins. Nearest-neighbor rendering; no log normalization.
data_source: Existing Git-tracked Mekong 15-minute map and optional analysis/visualization products; no model run, conversion or regeneration required.
required_data: map/mekong_15min/subcol-sample.bin (subbasin display colors); map/mekong_15min/netcdf/bsncol.nc (bsncol categorical display indices); map/mekong_15min/params.txt (grid geometry).
data_preparation: Sample is ready. Both s06-subbasin.sh wrappers use editable example thresholds AREA_THRESHOLD1_KM2=30000 and AREA_THRESHOLD2_KM2=5000 and explicit subbsn-sample.bin / subcol-sample.bin paths. Stage 2 only segments Stage 1 unassigned network cells, preserving 64 original IDs and adding 49; 686 cells remain unassigned. Neither threshold guarantees minimum segment area. subcol is a categorical display index, regenerated from final IDs. The f01d plotting script reads subcol-sample.bin and bsncol.nc; subbsn-sample.bin is not needed for plotting. Run visualization/river_map/f01-raster_river_map.sh; no map regeneration is required.

title: Line River Map: Connect Type
description: Directed river-network arrows: thicker black local D8 connections and curved orange Flexible Downstream connections.
purpose: Show explicit local and Flexible Downstream connectivity in the CaMa-Flood river network.
method: Every valid one-based nextxy link; black local arrows with 0.010-inch shafts and orange curved flexible arrows with smaller standard heads and rad=0.22; faint logarithmic uparea raster; no extent filtering.
data_source: Git-tracked CaMa-Flood Mekong 15-minute map; no station data or simulation output required.
required_data: map/mekong_15min/netcdf/uparea.nc (uparea, m2); map/mekong_15min/netcdf/nextxy_noedge.nc (nextx, nexty; one-based destination indices); map/mekong_15min/params.txt (grid geometry).
data_preparation: Tracked inputs are ready; run visualization/river_map/f02-line_river_map.sh after standard Python setup. All three panels draw every valid link; axes clip the common 99-109 E, 9-19 N view.

title: Line River Map: Enhance Tickness
description: All-black lines without arrowheads with enhanced thickness based on source-cell upstream drainage area.
purpose: Emphasize large rivers using thickness while retaining small links.
method: Six equal full-map log-area classes; actual shaft widths 0.008-0.032 inches; local links straight and flexible links curved; faint uparea raster; representative area-width legend; no arrowheads on local or flexible links; direction not explicitly marked; no extent filtering.
data_source: Git-tracked CaMa-Flood Mekong 15-minute map; no station data or simulation output required.
required_data: map/mekong_15min/netcdf/uparea.nc (uparea, m2); map/mekong_15min/netcdf/nextxy_noedge.nc (nextx, nexty; one-based destination indices); map/mekong_15min/params.txt (grid geometry).
data_preparation: Tracked inputs are ready; run visualization/river_map/f02-line_river_map.sh after standard Python setup. All three panels draw every valid link; axes clip the common 99-109 E, 9-19 N view.

title: Line River Map: Enhance Color
description: Arrowless straight local and curved Flexible Downstream links; shade-rainbow color and line width both encode source-cell upstream area over a light-gray subcol background.
purpose: Show source-cell contributing area through both line color and thickness while retaining the f02b link geometry.
method: Use cmf_colormap shade-rainbow with continuous full-map logarithmic area normalization for both line color and the six f02b width classes (0.008–0.032 inches). Draw every valid local link as a straight line and every flexible link as the f02b curved line, with no arrowheads. Draw subcol category 0 gray (0.50 brightness) and positive categories 1–10 as discrete grays from 0.45 to 0.10 brightness; -9999 and missing values are white. No extent filtering.
data_source: Git-tracked CaMa-Flood Mekong 15-minute map; no station data or simulation output required.
required_data: map/mekong_15min/netcdf/uparea.nc (uparea, m2); map/mekong_15min/netcdf/nextxy_noedge.nc (nextx, nexty; one-based destination indices); map/mekong_15min/subcol-sample.bin (one little-endian int32 Fortran-order record; categorical indices); map/mekong_15min/params.txt (grid dimensions and geometry).
data_preparation: Tracked inputs are ready. Run visualization/river_map/f02-line_river_map.sh after standard Python setup. f02c reads subcol-sample.bin directly and does not read bsncol.nc.

title: Vector River Map: Upstream Area
description: Directed main-network links connect each source cell outlet to the outlet of its nextxy downstream cell; source-cell upstream area is encoded by four map-derived quartile colors and widths.
purpose: Show the CaMa-Flood river topology at geographic unit-catchment outlets, distinct from connections drawn at computational grid-cell centers.
method: Interpret nextx/nexty as one-based downstream indices; connect the exact outlon/outlat of source and destination cells with directed straight segments. Convert source uparea from m² to km² for interpretation, then classify log10 area using full-map source-link quartiles. Use the four Tutorial02 Figure 1c colors and widths; no raster background or other overlays. Draw subcol-sample.bin behind the links: zero is gray, positive display indices 1–10 use pastel tab10 colors, and -9999 is white.
data_source: Git-tracked CaMa-Flood Mekong 15-minute map NetCDF products; no model output or external dataset required.
required_data: map/mekong_15min/netcdf/nextxy_noedge.nc (nextx, nexty); map/mekong_15min/netcdf/lonlat.nc (outlon, outlat); map/mekong_15min/netcdf/uparea.nc (uparea); map/mekong_15min/params.txt (grid geometry).; map/mekong_15min/subcol-sample.bin (little-endian int32; one Fortran-order display-index raster)
data_preparation: All inputs are tracked and ready to use. After standard Python setup, run visualization/river_map/f03-vector_river_map.sh; no separate preparation step is needed.

title: Vector River Map: Extended Network
description: Main-channel outlet links with mapped channel and overland bifurcations, plus headwater catchment-centroid guides.
purpose: Show how stored bifurcation topology and high-resolution unit-catchment geometry extend the main outlet network.
method: Use every valid nextxy link between the exact outlon/outlat outlet coordinates. Classify bifprm paths using first-layer width: positive-width channel bifurcations use four quartile colors, remaining paths are subdued green. For river cells without incoming regional main links, average the geographic centers of assigned catmxy pixels and connect that centroid to the cell outlet. Draw pale bsncol categories and subtle coarse-grid lines behind the network. Main-channel links have no direction arrows; small white circles mark valid outlet pixels. Channel and overland bifurcation arrows remain centered on their links.
data_source: Git-tracked Mekong 15-minute map and 1-minute catchment-allocation products; no simulation output or external data required.
required_data: map/mekong_15min/netcdf/nextxy_noedge.nc (nextx,nexty); lonlat.nc (outlon,outlat); uparea.nc (uparea); bsncol.nc (bsncol); bifprm.nc (ix,iy,jx,jy,width); map/mekong_15min/1min/1min.catmxy.bin (catmx,catmy int16); 1min/location.txt; map/mekong_15min/params.txt.
data_preparation: All inputs are tracked and ready. Run visualization/river_map/f03-vector_river_map.sh after standard Python setup. Bifurcation links are taken from bifprm, not inferred from proximity. Map-edge cells without incoming regional links may be truncated headwater candidates; the current map has 220 such candidates. Centroid-to-outlet segments are geometric summaries, not channel paths.

title: River Map Catchment: Upstream Area at Unit Catchment
description: High-resolution 1-minute unit-catchment pixels colored by upstream area at unit-catchment, with unassigned land, catchment boundaries, 15-minute grid, outlet-based main-channel arrows, headwater guides, and channel-bifurcation arrows; observation-site data are excluded.
purpose: Relate 1-minute catchment geometry and upstream area at unit-catchment to stored main-channel outlets and channel bifurcations.
method: Each assigned catmxy pixel inherits its one-based coarse cell uparea divided by 1e6 and is colored with a logarithmic pale-yellow-to-green scale; catmxy=-999 land pixels are gray and other unassigned/background pixels are white. Fine assignment boundaries and faint 15-minute grid lines are drawn. Main nextxy links connect exact outlon/outlat outlets; four visible-link log-area quartiles encode upstream area at unit-catchment with blue color/width and fig01d-style arrows. Thin gray guides connect mean centers of assigned pixels in regional headwater cells (no incoming valid nextxy link) to their outlets. Unique bifprm paths with positive first-layer width are channel bifurcations; four visible path-width quartiles set red color/width and arrows. Overland paths and observation-site data/markers/connectors are excluded.
data_source: Git-tracked Mekong 15-minute map and 1-minute catchment-assignment products; no simulation output or station data required.
required_data: map/mekong_15min/1min/1min.catmxy.bin; map/mekong_15min/1min/location.txt; map/mekong_15min/netcdf/uparea.nc; map/mekong_15min/netcdf/nextxy_noedge.nc; map/mekong_15min/netcdf/lonlat.nc; map/mekong_15min/netcdf/bifprm.nc; map/mekong_15min/params.txt.
data_preparation: Inputs are ready. After standard Python setup, run visualization/river_map/f04-rivmap_catchment.sh. The script writes f04a-rivmap_catchment-outlet_uparea.png, f04b-rivmap_catchment-channel_pixel.png, and the combined f04-rivmap_catchment.png under visualization/river_map/figure/. Gallery assets are not modified.

title: River Map Catchment: Channel Pixel
description: Upstream-area-colored 1-minute unit catchments with main-channel and small-stream pixels highlighted from visual categories, plus the outlet-based river network.
purpose: Relate high-resolution channel-pixel classifications to unit-catchment area and the stored river network.
method: Read visual as signed int8 in 1-minute raster order. Overlay visual=10 as pale blue main-channel pixels and visual=7 as pale purple source-defined small-stream pixels only where catmxy assigns a valid coarse river cell. Keep the shared uparea background, boundaries, grid, outlet-based nextxy links, headwater guides, and positive-first-layer-width channel bifurcations from p01-f04a. The binary missing value is -9; CTL undef 247 is not the binary sentinel.
data_source: Git-tracked Mekong 15-minute map and 1-minute catchment-assignment/visualization products; no simulation output or station data required.
required_data: map/mekong_15min/1min/1min.catmxy.bin; map/mekong_15min/1min/1min.visual.bin; map/mekong_15min/1min/location.txt; map/mekong_15min/netcdf/uparea.nc; map/mekong_15min/netcdf/nextxy_noedge.nc; map/mekong_15min/netcdf/lonlat.nc; map/mekong_15min/netcdf/bifprm.nc; map/mekong_15min/params.txt.
data_preparation: Inputs are ready. After standard Python setup, run visualization/river_map/f04-rivmap_catchment.sh. The script writes f04a-rivmap_catchment-outlet_uparea.png, f04b-rivmap_catchment-channel_pixel.png, and the combined f04-rivmap_catchment.png under visualization/river_map/figure/. Gallery assets are not modified.
